exports.ucImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter, responseFormats [url, b64_json])
exports.ucVideoAdapter: default video adapter instance (VIDEO_GENERATION_ADAPTERS contract, async, responseFormats [url])
exports.createUcImageAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, now } for tests
exports.createUcVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildUcImageRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, n, size? }; throws status 400
exports.buildUcVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, size?, aspect_ratio?, resolution?, duration?, image? }; throws status 400
exports.runUcVideoJob: submit + bounded status_url poll; { success, url, jobId, answer } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.extractUcVideo: source extractUcDirectVideo: { url?, statusUrl?, status?, requestId? }
exports.ucAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState, jobId?) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.ucPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results and input image URLs
exports.ucToken: uai_ developer key of the selected connection, or null
exports.UC_PROVIDER_MEDIA_ADDITIONS: serviceKinds, model kinds and imageConfig to add to the existing uc-direct registry entry
exports.UC_VIDEO_MODELS: 13 source REST video ids with input text | image | any
exports.UC_PERSONA_ENDPOINTS: persona endpoints from the source, evidence only, never called

provider.sourceIdDisposition: OmniRoute keys both media entries as `uc` (persona provider). The fork has no `uc` provider: the consumer-app persona path was retired in #1241 (closed not planned); the documented replacement is `uc-direct` (#1242). Do not add a `uc` alias.

auth.existingEntryAuth: transport.auth { combined: true, header: x-api-key, scheme: raw } unchanged

notEquivalent.uc-direct (current registry entry): same vendor, origin and key, but LLM only: serviceKinds [llm], no imageConfig, no image or video adapter
notEquivalent.generic OpenAI image adapter (imageProvi: sends Authorization: Bearer; UC Direct needs X-api-key, and the generic adapter defaults size and forwards options the source never sent
notEquivalent./v1/videos proxy (videoCore.js): no uc-direct videoConfig, hands job ids to the client, no status_url origin check, no accepted-job ledger
notEquivalent.uc persona (OmniRoute `uc`): Clerk JWT minted from consumer-app cookies; retired in #1241, not staged

notStaged.wan-2.2-spicy: persona picker default, not in the source REST catalog

models.bareIdCollisions: several image ids (nano-banana, z-image-turbo, gpt-image) also exist under other providers; the source keeps `uc` last so bare ids resolve to their historical owner. Register these as uc-direct-scoped models only.
models.dynamicDiscovery: none for media in the source (static registry lists). The existing uc-direct modelsFetcher (GET https://api.uncensored.com/api/v1/models, openai) stays the LLM catalog and is not reused for media kinds.
